function.name: geocode_address

I don’t have access to live traffic feeds, so I can’t give you a real‑time snapshot of congestion in New York right now.  

**Typical traffic patterns in NYC**

| Time of day | Typical congestion | Notes |
|-------------|--------------------|-------|
| 6 – 9 am (weekday) | Heavy on major arteries (Broadway, 5th Ave, I‑95, I‑495, I‑278) | Rush‑hour inbound traffic from suburbs |
| 3 – 6 pm (weekday) | Heavy on outbound routes (I‑95, I‑495, I‑278, I‑87) | Rush‑hour outbound traffic to suburbs |
| Weekends | Light to moderate | Some events (parades, festivals) can cause local bottlenecks |
| Late night | Light | Traffic drops significantly after midnight |

If you need up‑to‑date conditions, the best sources are:

* **Google Maps** – real‑time traffic layers and incident reports  
* **Waze** – community‑reported incidents and road closures  
* **NYC DOT** – traffic camera feeds and incident alerts (https://www.nyc.gov/html/dot/html/home/traffic-camera.shtml)

Let me know if you’d like a quick guide on how to set up a traffic alert or if there’s anything else I can help with!
